description: Fibocom FM350-GL, RNDIS + AT composition 0e8d:7126 (AT+GTUSBMODE? 40); historical AT port ttyUSB1

hints.at_source: a tester's FM350-GL, firmware 29.24.02 F32, GTUSBMODE 40 (2026-11-19): MD AT is interface 4 (ttyUSB1), the only port that answers; 6, inherited from the 7127 composition, is NPT and silent (dial failed «AT+COPS?: no answer»)
